📋 Community Standards

Student Community Guidelines

These guidelines exist to keep CampusConnect safe, trustworthy, and useful for every student on campus.

info

Important: By registering on CampusConnect, you agree to follow these community guidelines. Violations may result in warnings, listing removal, temporary suspension, or permanent account termination depending on severity.

check_circle What You CAN Do

storefront
Buy & Sell Legitimate ItemsList textbooks, electronics, furniture, clothing, and any legal item relevant to student life. All prices must be in FCFA.
design_services
Offer Student ServicesPromote tutoring, graphic design, photography, coding help, and other student-run services.
forum
Message Other Students RespectfullyUse the chat feature to discuss listings, negotiate prices, and coordinate pickups professionally.
work
Post Genuine Internship OpportunitiesPost real internships and job opportunities relevant to university students at your institution.
flag
Report Suspicious ActivityUse the report button whenever you encounter content that violates these guidelines. You help keep everyone safe.

cancel What You CANNOT Do

dangerous
No Prohibited or Illegal ItemsSelling drugs, weapons, counterfeit goods, stolen property, or any illegal item is strictly prohibited and will result in immediate account termination and may be reported to university authorities.
scam
No Scams or FraudDo not post misleading listings, fake photos, or misrepresent items. Taking payment without delivering goods is fraud and will result in permanent ban.
block
No Harassment or AbuseThreatening, bullying, or using hate speech in messages or listings is not tolerated under any circumstances.
no_accounts
No Fake AccountsYou must use your real university email to register. Creating multiple accounts or impersonating others will result in all accounts being banned.
spam
No Spam or Duplicate ListingsDo not post the same listing multiple times, send unsolicited messages in bulk, or flood the platform with irrelevant content.
attach_money
No Off-Platform PaymentsAll price negotiations should be discussed in the app. We cannot protect you from disputes that occur outside the platform.

gavel Enforcement Process

We take guidelines violations seriously. Here's how enforcement works:

1

Warning

First minor violation receives a formal warning via email and notification.

2

Listing Removal

Violating listings are removed immediately, with explanation provided.

3

Temporary Suspension

Repeat or serious violations result in 7–30 day account suspension.

4

Permanent Ban

Severe or repeated violations result in permanent account termination.

Questions about our guidelines?

Our support team is here to help. Visit the Help Center for more information.
